allocation_rule: Four exclusive lanes run independently against one frozen Shared/App contract snapshot. Workers do not wait for other lanes or HQ release between macro bundles. HQ integrates at checkpoints later.
lane_execution_rules: At epoch-2 start each Worker syncs once to latest integration and records base_integration_sha.
After that, normal integration-branch movement in other lanes is ignored until lane checkpoint; do not rebase on unrelated changes.
On each user '次', execute exactly the next incomplete macro bundle in lane-plan-v3.json through implementation, tests and durable evidence.
Do not stop because an internal subtask finished. Stop only when the macro bundle done_when is met or a hard blocker/ownership conflict exists.
When a bundle finishes, record it in the Worker status file and immediately nominate the next bundle; HQ approval is not required.
If one bundle is externally blocked, continue the next preloaded bundle that does not require that external input while staying inside the same lane.
Worker-to-Worker code dependencies are deferred to HQ late integration. A Worker must not modify another lane to make its own bundle pass.
integration_rules: HQ does not merge after every macro bundle.
Default checkpoint is after multiple completed bundles or when a lane reaches a coherent integration milestone.
HQ performs semantic merge, cross-lane compile, device validation and PARITY judgment later.
Before the next checkpoint is consumed, HQ preloads the next set of at least four macro bundles per active lane so task starvation cannot recur.
